_que_es: Lo que montó el motor de láminas (lib/motion.py) para «The Pear of Anguish», publicado el 16-09-2026 por un canal del estudio: el montaje.json de su run → detalle, y de su slides.json el título y la descripción de cada lámina. Lo usa tests/escena/test_laminas.py (F6.8).
titulo: The Pear of Anguish: The Museum Piece With No Medieval Past

laminas.image_prompt: a museum gallery with plain plastered walls, seen straight on in the morning. in the centre a plinth with a flat top at the height of a table, and on the top a single small metal instrument lying on a folded cloth, fifteen centimetres from its tip to the end of its key: four curved segments closed together into one tapering shape, a threaded screw running down their axis, a collar where the segments meet the screw, and a winged key at the base as long as the segments. a blank card on a small stand beside it, the card about as long as the instrument. a low bench against the far wall, the gallery otherwise empty. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the instrument, which is in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a close study on a plain wooden table seen from above, the table filling the picture. a single small metal instrument lies in the centre with its four segments swung apart: four curved segments hinged at the base and opened outward like petals, a threaded screw standing along the axis between them, a collar at the base of the segments, and a winged key below the collar as long as the segments themselves. the whole piece fifteen centimetres from tip to key. a folded cloth and a blank card of the same length lie at the edge of the table for scale, and the table is otherwise bare. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the instrument, which is in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a close view of a small blank card resting on a folding metal card stand on the top of a plinth, the card seen at a slight angle and its face smooth and blank. behind it, out of the way at the back of the plinth, the closed shape of a small metal instrument fifteen centimetres long with four curved segments and a winged key. a plain plastered wall behind, nothing else in the picture. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the card stand, which is in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

an extreme close study on a plain plastered surface: the lower half of a small metal instrument, showing a threaded screw with its spiral running its whole length, the collar it passes through, the hinged feet of four curved segments arranged around the collar, and the winged key fixed to the bottom of the screw. the rest of the instrument out of the picture above. a brass ruler lies alongside, the visible part fifteen centimetres long. nothing else in the picture. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the screw and its collar, which are in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a plain wooden bench top seen straight on, lit from one side. two objects lie side by side and parallel: on the left the closed body of a small metal instrument, four curved segments meeting in one tapering shape with a collar at the base; on the right its winged key detached, laid out to show that it is the same length as the body. a folded cloth under both of them and a blank card at the end of the bench for scale. the bench otherwise bare, a plain plastered wall behind. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the key, which is in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a glass display case standing on a plinth in a gallery, seen straight on and slightly from the side. inside the case, alone on a flat cloth covered board, the closed shape of a small metal instrument fifteen centimetres long: four curved segments meeting in one tapering point, a collar at the base and a winged key below it. a directed ceiling light throws a clean pool of light on the board. a blank card on a stand at the front of the case. plain plastered walls behind, the gallery empty. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the instrument, which is in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

the inside of a collector's cabinet seen straight on, with glazed doors standing open: three shelves at different heights, each with a few small objects placed far apart, their shapes simple and indistinct in the shadow of the shelf above. on the middle shelf, at the front and alone, the closed shape of a small metal instrument fifteen centimetres long with four curved segments, a collar and a winged key. a row of small drawers with ring pulls below the shelves. a plain plastered wall to the side. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the instrument, which is in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a dim visitor attraction room with plain plastered walls, seen straight on. a curtained alcove at the back with the curtain drawn shut, an empty wooden chair in front of it turned to one side, and across the foreground a barrier of two metal posts with a rope looped between them at waist height. a wooden sign board on the wall, completely blank. the room empty and still. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the two rope posts, which are in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a plain wooden table in a store room, seen straight on. on the left half of the table, alone, the closed shape of a small metal instrument fifteen centimetres long: four curved segments meeting in one tapering point, a threaded screw down the axis, a collar and a winged key. on the right half, a closed book lying flat with its covers shut and a strap around it. an equal space between the two objects, and nothing else on the table. metal shelving in shadow behind. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the instrument, which is in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a close view of an empty plinth in a gallery, its flat top bare, seen straight on. in front of the plinth, at the edge of its top, a small blank card leans on a folding metal card stand, its face smooth and blank, and it is the only object in the picture. a plain plastered wall behind, a directed ceiling light throwing a pool of light on the empty top. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the card stand, which is in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a gallery corner with plain plastered walls, seen straight on. in the foreground a barrier of two metal posts with a rope looped between them at waist height, running across the picture. behind the rope, a lit glass case on a plinth with a small blank card at its front, and inside the case a shape too small to read clearly. the gallery empty, a doorway in shadow at the side. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the rope posts, which are in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

an extreme close study of a threaded screw standing upright between four curved metal segments hinged at their base, the spiral of the thread clearly drawn turn by turn along the shaft, the collar the screw passes through, and the top of a winged key at the bottom edge of the picture. a pair of calipers lies open beside the collar with its jaws set to the width of the shaft. a plain plastered surface behind, nothing else in the picture. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the screw, which is in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a plain wooden table seen from above, filling the picture, divided by the empty space down its middle. on one side the closed shape of a small metal instrument fifteen centimetres long with four curved segments, a collar and a winged key, lying on a folded cloth. on the other side a closed book lying flat with a strap around it and a blank card resting on top. nothing between them, the table otherwise bare. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the instrument, which is in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a workshop bench seen straight on in daylight from a side window. laid out in a row along the bench: a bench vice bolted at the end, a hand drill with a crank, a pair of calipers lying open, and a small spreading tool with two hinged arms and a screw between them. a plain plastered wall behind with a rack of pegs, the workshop empty and still. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the spreading tool with its screw, which is in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a plain wooden table in a quiet office, seen straight on. in the centre, a single closed ledger lying flat with a metal clasp holding its covers shut and a metal corner at each edge, the ledger the size of a large book. beside it an inkstand with two wells and a pen resting in a groove. a plain plastered wall behind with one shuttered window, the room empty. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the clasp and the corners of the ledger, which are in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a close view of a card index drawer pulled out of a wooden cabinet on a table, seen from above and slightly to the side. inside the drawer, a long row of upright cards standing edge on, their tops blank, with a metal rod running through them near the bottom and a ring pull on the front of the drawer. the rest of the cabinet with its other drawers closed behind. a plain plastered wall to the side, nothing else on the table. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the ring pull and the rod, which are in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a wooden packing crate standing open on a store room floor, seen straight on and slightly from above, its lid leaning against the side. inside the crate, packing straw and, resting in a hollow of the straw, the closed shape of a small metal instrument fifteen centimetres long with four curved segments, a collar and a winged key. a blank shipping label tied to the handle of the crate. metal shelving in shadow behind, the store room empty. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the instrument, which is in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a plain plastered wall in a store room, seen straight on. a metal hook fixed at head height with a ring of large keys hanging from it, six keys of different lengths on one ring. below the hook, a narrow shelf with a closed ledger lying flat and a pair of folded cotton gloves beside it. nothing else on the wall, the room empty. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the ring of keys, which is in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a gallery with plain plastered walls and a tall sash window with slim glazing bars, seen straight on in flat daylight. in front of the window and to one side, a plinth with a flat top, and on the top, alone, the closed shape of a small metal instrument fifteen centimetres long with four curved segments, a collar and a winged key, resting on a folded cloth. a cast iron radiator under the window and a low bench against the side wall. the room empty. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the instrument, which is in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

an empty court room seen straight on from the back, with plain plastered walls and panelled woodwork. a long clerk's table in the foreground with a closed register lying shut on it, an inkstand with two wells, and a hand bell standing beside them. behind the table a raised bench with an empty chair. a tall window to one side, the room empty and still. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the hand bell, which is in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a long shelf of closed ledgers standing upright side by side in an archive, seen straight on at eye level, their spines plain and unmarked. near the middle of the row, one empty gap the width of a single ledger, with the shelf board visible through it. a metal bracket supporting the shelf at each end and a second shelf above in shadow. nothing else in the picture, the archive empty and still. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the shelf brackets, which are in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a sloped reading desk in a quiet library, seen straight on. on the desk, a closed academic journal lying flat, its covers plain and unmarked, with a paper bookmark showing at the top edge. a pair of spectacles with metal frames folded beside it, and a small reading rest at the top of the slope. plain panelled woodwork behind and one shuttered window to the side, the room empty. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the spectacle frames, which are in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a long exhibition room in the nineteenth century with plain plastered walls, seen down its length from one end. a row of glass topped display tables on turned legs runs down the middle, each table holding a few small objects placed far apart, their shapes simple and indistinct under the glass. a plain moulded cornice above and a row of tall windows along one side. the room empty and still. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the metal frames of the display tables, which are in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

an empty corridor with a plastered barrel vault overhead, seen straight on down its length in dim light from a small side window. at the far end, a low door with iron studs across it, two long strap hinges and a ring handle, standing shut in its frame. a plain plastered floor and bare plastered walls on both sides, the corridor empty and still. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the studs, hinges and ring handle of the door, which are in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a glass display case on a plinth seen from a low angle and slightly to the side, so that the front glass carries a clear reflection. inside the case, alone on a cloth covered board, the closed shape of a small metal instrument fifteen centimetres long with four curved segments, a collar and a winged key. the same shape appears again in the reflection on the glass, fainter and reversed. a plain plastered wall behind, the gallery empty. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the instrument and its reflection, which are in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a catalogue plate: a plain flat background filling the whole picture, and centred on it the closed shape of a small metal instrument seen straight on, fifteen centimetres from tip to key, its four curved segments meeting in one tapering point, the collar at the base and the winged key below. a small scale bar of five marked divisions lies along the bottom edge beside it. the piece alone on the flat background, and nothing else at all in the picture. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the instrument, which is in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a close view of a small blank card resting on a folding metal card stand on the flat top of a plinth, seen almost straight on and filling most of the picture, the face of the card smooth and blank. behind the card and set back, the closed shape of a small metal instrument fifteen centimetres long with four curved segments and a winged key, lying on a folded cloth. a plain plastered wall behind. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the card stand, which is in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a close view of the front edge of an old display case, seen straight on. a small label frame of metal is screwed to the wood below the glass, with four screw heads at its corners and a blank panel inside it with a smooth empty face. the glass above reflects a plain plastered wall. a second empty frame further along the case at the edge of the picture. nothing else in the picture. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the label frame and its screws, which are in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a glass display case on a plinth with its hinged front standing open, seen straight on in a gallery with plain plastered walls. inside, alone on a cloth covered board, the closed shape of a small metal instrument fifteen centimetres long with four curved segments, a collar and a winged key. a blank card lying flat beside it and a pair of folded cotton gloves on the edge of the open front. a directed ceiling light on the board, the gallery empty. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the instrument, which is in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a metalworker's bench seen straight on in daylight from a side window. laid out along the bench: a screw cutting die in its stock, a hand vice with its jaws closed, a small mandrel, and a short length of threaded rod resting in a wooden cradle. a rack of pegs on the plain plastered wall behind with a few plain tools hanging from it. the workshop empty and still. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the screw cutting die and its stock, which are in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

a plain wooden bench top seen from directly above, filling the picture. a small metal instrument taken apart and laid out in a row across the bench: four curved segments side by side, then the threaded screw, then the collar, then the winged key at the end, each piece separated by a finger's width of bare wood. a folded cloth under the row and a blank card at one end for scale, the bench otherwise bare. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the laid out pieces, which are in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.

an empty plinth in a gallery with plain plastered walls, seen straight on, its glass case lifted away and set on the floor beside it. the flat top of the plinth bare except for a folded cloth and a small blank card lying flat on it, and a folding metal card stand standing empty at the front edge. a doorway in shadow behind, the gallery otherwise empty. the whole image is monochrome sepia except the card stand, which is in verdigris, the only colour in the picture, in the same pen and ink hatching, only tinted.
